the LCG and the OSG grids are a good platform for the distribution of CMS software.
the LCG and Open Science Grids have been very successful in providing a large and stable infrastructure for CMS.
- CMS software is deployed and used in the LHC computing grid, and the CMS software is deployed in the Open Science Grid (OSG) and the Worldwide LHC Computing Grid (WLCG).

the efficient distribution and installation of CMS specific software in a grid environment.
the efficient deployment of software on distributed computing resources.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the LCG and the OSG grids are a mature and reliable platform for scientific computing.
CMS software distribution on the LCG/EGEE and OSG grids is working well and that the current status is very satisfactory.
CMS software distribution is working and is being improved.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are currently able to distribute software in a transparent way to more than 200 sites in 30 countries.

we are now able to deploy the CMS software on the grid in a transparent way, without requiring any specific grid knowledge from the users, and with an efficiency comparable to that of a local installation.
we are able to deploy the software to a large number of machines in the grid, and that the software is usable by the users in the CMS collaboration.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the CMS experiment is able to efficiently deploy software on the grid and to use it for production and development purposes.
